setup_bootstrap.disabled_while_an_etl_ru: Disabled while an ETL run is in progress.
setup_bootstrap.first_set_up_the_databas: First, set up the database. Then you'll choose whether to start a new world or join an existing mesh — and, if you're starting fresh, create your operator account.
setup_joinhost.already_connected_to_a_ho: Already connected to a host — this resumes the sync where it left off (no host URL needed).
setup_joinhost.checks_the_public_front_d: Checks the public front door, and — if you opt in — scans your own local network. No address needed.
setup_joinhost.connect_this_node_to_a_fe: Connect this node to a federation already in play. It syncs the whole game — map foundation, constitution, and institutions — and becomes a read-only mirror. There's no institution-building: you're playing the same game as the rest of the mesh.
setup_joinhost.connected_pulling_the_cor: Connected — pulling the corpus in the background. Live progress is shown below; this finishes on its own (and resumes if interrupted). You can leave this page.
setup_joinhost.host_adoption_console_pen: Host adoption console → Pending adoption requests
setup_joinhost.join_key_optional_leave_b: Join key (optional — leave blank to request the host operator's approval)
setup_joinhost.no_federations_found_ente: No federations found. Enter a host URL manually below, or check your network range and try again.
setup_joinhost.request_sent_the_host_ope: Request sent — the host operator must approve it.
setup_joinhost.this_node_s_mesh_id_give_: This node's mesh id (give it to the host)
setup_modefork.build_the_game_here_autho: Build the game here — author the constitution, load the map, draw districts, seat the institutions. You become the canonical game, and other nodes federate to you. Recommended for the first node in a federation.
setup_modefork.connect_to_a_host_already: Connect to a host already in the federation. Everything syncs in — the map foundation, the constitution, and every institution — and this node becomes a read-only mirror. No institution-building; you're playing the same game as the rest of the mesh.
setup_modefork.how_should_this_node_join: How should this node join the game?
setup_modefork.this_choice_is_one_way_fo: This choice is one-way for the life of the instance. Tearing down and starting over is docker compose down -v.
setup_modefork.your_operator_account_is_: Your operator account is set up. Every node in a mesh plays the same game — so the only question is whether this node starts a world or joins one that already exists.
setup_operatorsetup.create_the_account_t: Create the account that runs this node, give the box an address, and turn on your operator roles. You're the founding operator, so every role is yours to switch on directly.
setup_operatorsetup.hand_a_colleague_a_o: Hand a colleague a one-file start script. Solo = they found their own world; Join = they mirror this one (needs your node address set above).
setup_operatorsetup.infrastructure_confi: Infrastructure config comes next — you can turn a role on now and finish its setup there.
setup_operatorsetup.just_me_for_now_runs: Just me, for now Runs on this computer. No address needed — you can open it to others later when you're ready to accept peers.
setup_operatorsetup.localhost_only_works: — localhost only works on this computer; use your LAN/public address for real peers.
setup_operatorsetup.prefer_the_full_cons: Prefer the full console? Open the operator console →
setup_operatorsetup.roles_become_availab: Roles become available once the operator account above is created.
setup_operatorsetup.running_a_node_carri: Running a node carries operator roles on the mesh — infrastructure duties, not citizen privilege (they buy no vote or seat). As the founding operator you self-assert them directly, right here; once a government seats, governed roles return to shared consent for later changes.
setup_operatorsetup.set_a_reachable_node: Set a reachable node address above first, or the join script won't know where to dial.
setup_operatorsetup.set_the_address_peer: Set the address peers dial to reach this box.
setup_operatorsetup.some_roles_still_nee: Some roles still need setup before they work:
setup_operatorsetup.the_address_changed_: The address changed. Re-run the start command (docker compose up -d) so the containers pick it up before peers join.
setup_operatorsetup.who_should_be_able_t: Who should be able to reach this node?
setup_operatorsetup.your_physical_operat: Your physical-operator credentials — the account that runs and governs this node.
setup_step0_cosmicaddress.a_friendly_lab: A friendly label for this install — shown in nav and federation directories.
setup_step0_cosmicaddress.compressed_sim: Compressed simulation — pick seconds per simulated year.
setup_step0_cosmicaddress.let_s_set_your: Let's set your cosmic address — the anchor your instance will federate under.
setup_step0_cosmicaddress.this_is_the_co: This is the Cosmopolitan Governance App — a federated, open-source platform implementing A Fair Constitution. It models every institution the Template defines (residency, elections, legislatures, executives, judiciaries, organizations) as interactive, automatable software, from neighborhood scale up to planetary scale and beyond.
setup_step1_constants.a_world_wide_setti: A world-wide setting. Choose how strictly this world enforces its constitution. Saved immediately when you pick.
setup_step1_constants.citizen_initiative: Citizen Initiative Petition Threshold (% of population)
setup_step1_constants.civic_duty_pay_for: Civic-duty pay for elected & appointed officers. Default: 12
Civic-duty pay for the people running nodes. Default: 8
setup_step1_constants.default_of_default: Default of defaults: 10 years · Art. II §9
Default of defaults: 10 years · Art. IV §4
Default of defaults: 180 days · Art. II §5 · must be ≥ min.
Default of defaults: 2/3 · Art. VII · must exceed 1/2 (simple majority).
Default of defaults: 2000 · Art. III §6 · must be ≥ first-seat threshold.
Default of defaults: 30 days of qualifying GPS pings before residency is confirmed and voting/candidacy rights unlock.
Default of defaults: 60 months (5 years) · Art. II §2 {acceleratedHint}
Default of defaults: 9 (before mandatory subdivision) · Art. II §2
Default of defaults: 90 days · Art. II §2
Default of defaults: 90 days · Art. II §5
Default of defaults: 90 days · Art. II §7
Default of defaults: Appointed · Art. IV §1

Default of defaults: Shortest split-line · When an area earns more seats than the maximum but has no smaller subdivisions to group, the autoseeder cuts its territory directly using this method. The district mapper can still override per run.
Default of defaults: STV Droop · Art. II §2 · currently the only implemented algorithm.
setup_step1_constants.everyone_with_acti: Everyone with active residency receives this. Default: 50
setup_step1_constants.how_often_the_econ: How often the economic clock pays out.
setup_step1_constants.set_once_inherited: Set once, inherited everywhere. Every constitutional and economic default here seeds each jurisdiction's own amendable settings and cascades to new child jurisdictions as they come online — so they don't reinvent the wheel. Each jurisdiction can still amend its own values locally once its legitimacy gate activates. The game mode below is a world-wide property, not per-jurisdiction.
setup_step1_constants.shortest_split_lin: Shortest split-line — shortest balanced cuts (compact, default)
setup_step1_constants.shown_on_wallets_a: Shown on wallets and the exchange.
setup_step1_constants.special_election_m: Special Election — Max Days After Vacancy
Special Election — Min Days After Vacancy
setup_step1_constants.the_most_the_role_: The most the role differentials can add. Default: 20
setup_step1_constants.the_starting_econo: The starting economy for your world — these cascade to child jurisdictions just like the constitutional ones.
setup_step1_constants.total_legislature_: Total legislature size is computed from population, then clamped to [min, max], then partitioned into districts of size [min_seats, max_seats].
setup_step1_constants.you_are_founding_t: You are founding the constitution and its economy now — the values below are the Fair Constitution Template's suggested defaults (the "defaults of defaults"), shown as reference. You can depart from them here. After setup, any further amendments must go through valid legislative acts.
setup_step2_mapdata.basemap_tiles_protom: Basemap tiles — Protomaps maps.protomaps.com · vector planet basemap for the map background
setup_step2_mapdata.fetch_the_open_datas: Fetch the open datasets straight from their official repos, then ingest. Country scope is optional — leave it empty (in Run Options below) to download all countries.
setup_step2_mapdata.heads_up_the_protoma: Heads up: the Protomaps planet build is ~100 GB and takes a long time to download. Only fetch it if you want the full-world basemap.
setup_step2_mapdata.if_your_map_files_li: If your map files live somewhere else on this computer, enter that folder here. It's written to ARCHIVE_PATH in your .env so the container remounts /archive from it. On Windows, use your host path (e.g. D:\fair-constitution-map-files).
setup_step2_mapdata.ingest_a_specific_co: Ingest a specific container path — an alternate snapshot or a sub-directory of /archive. (To point at a different folder on your computer, use "Point at a local folder" above instead.)
setup_step2_mapdata.ingest_whatever_is_d: Ingest whatever is detected above at the container path {sources} (mapped from your ARCHIVE_PATH folder). Fastest path — no network.
setup_step2_mapdata.load_at_least_one_na: Load at least one nation (ADM1) before continuing
setup_step2_mapdata.no_country_scope_set: No country scope set — this downloads ALL countries (the whole world). Expect 14 GB+ of boundary + population data and hours of download time. To limit it, enter an ISO3 list in Run Options below (e.g. NZL,USA).
setup_step2_mapdata.open_data_flag_revie: ⚑ {open} open data flag{flagState} — review & repair in the Jurisdiction Viewer → {critical} critical {warning} warning {info} info
setup_step2_mapdata.pause_on_first_excep: Pause on first exception When any country errors, pause the run and let you skip that country, retry, or abort. Without this, the run logs the error and continues.
setup_step2_mapdata.point_at_your_map_da: Point at your map data, then run the ETL pipeline. Progress streams live from the ETL container. Once the run completes, review any flagged discrepancies before continuing to districting.
setup_step2_mapdata.population_worldpop_: Population — WorldPop data.worldpop.org (CC BY 4.0) · pulls boundaries too (needed to attribute population)
setup_step2_mapdata.running_cube_root_ap: Running cube-root apportionment across the jurisdiction tree…
setup_step2_mapdata.the_archive_mount_is: The archive mount {archive_mount} is not present in the ETL container. Set your local folder below (then restart), or download the data from the official sources.
setup_step2_mapdata.the_etl_reads_from_t: The ETL reads from the container path {sources}, which your .env maps from a folder on your computer (ARCHIVE_PATH). If nothing is detected below, the mount is empty or pointed at the wrong folder — set your local folder or download the data further down.
setup_step2_mapdata.the_import_finished_: The import finished. Open the jurisdiction viewer to inspect boundaries, populations, raster overlays, dual-footprint relationships, and any flagged discrepancies — then accept the map data there (planet scope). Click Continue below once accepted — that triggers apportionment.
setup_step2_mapdata.upload_a_tarball_or_: Upload a tarball or folder from this browser. Multipart upload handler not yet wired.
setup_step2_mapdata.you_pointed_the_app_: You pointed the app at {sources}, but the containers haven't picked it up yet. Run this in the app folder (it recreates the containers — a stop/start or restart is not enough), then click Re-check:
setup_step3_districts.a_banner_at_the_to: A banner at the top of the mapper will remind you you're in setup mode.
setup_step3_districts.accepting_the_map_: Accepting the map data kicked off the full-scale build: every jurisdiction gets a legislature sized by the cube-root law, and every legislature gets a founding district map — real mixed-autoseed sweeps for jurisdictions with constituents, single at-large councils for the leaves. You can walk away; the run self-heals from any crash within minutes and this page tracks it live.
setup_step3_districts.completed_maps_sea: {run} completed maps seat a total that differs from their legislature's apportioned seats (net {run2}{run3}). Drift is a defect. The head distributes to the children, so a map's seats must sum to its apportioned total. These maps need a redraw.
setup_step3_districts.cube_root_sizing_a: Cube-root sizing applied per Taagepera's law — every jurisdiction, all the way down.
setup_step3_districts.geometry_precomput: Geometry precompute (sibling borders, paid once){shown} / {precompute} · {failed} fall back live
setup_step3_districts.halt_the_full_scal: Halt the full-scale run? Workers stop at their next claim boundary; everything already committed stays. You can resume any time.
setup_step3_districts.review_items_above: Review items above link straight into the affected legislature's mapper.
setup_step3_districts.spot_check_any_leg: Spot-check any legislature in the interactive district mapper — the {root_jurisdiction} map is the natural first look. Reading is always safe mid-run; a legislature currently being swept has its autoseed controls locked until its sweep finishes.
setup_step3_districts.step_1_must_finish: Step 1 must finish loading at least ADM0 data before districts can be drawn. Go back to the map-data step to verify.
setup_step3_districts.you_can_always_com: You can always come back here by visiting /setup.
setup_step4_confirm.existing_institution: Existing institution rows detected ({existing_executives} executives, {existing_judiciaries} judiciaries) — they'll be left alone.
setup_step4_confirm.for_every_jurisdicti: For every jurisdiction with a legislature we'll insert one executives row (default type: committee) and one judiciaries row (default type: appointed, min 5 judges, 10-year terms).
setup_step4_confirm.no_members_or_seats_: No members or seats are populated — those land via the elections engine. Status stays forming until Phase 2.
setup_step4_confirm.one_per_jurisdiction: One per jurisdiction with direct children, sized by cube-root law.
setup_step4_confirm.per_the_maps_you_bui: Per the maps you built or auto-composited in Step 3.
setup_step4_confirm.review_the_shape_of_: Review the shape of your instance, then seat the executive and judicial institutions for every jurisdiction with a legislature. They start forming — actual members get elected once the elections engine ships in Phase 2 of the master roadmap.
setup_step4_confirm.we_ll_record_setup_c: We'll record setup_completed_at on the instance settings. From this point /setup redirects home.
setup_step4_confirm.what_happens_when_yo: What happens when you click Finish
setup_step4_confirm.your_instance_is_set: Your instance is set up. Legislatures are sized, districts are drawn, and the executive + judicial institutions are scaffolded and waiting for their first elections. Welcome to your fair constitution.
